items.title: Roscoe Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2023
items.q: Anthony Braxton could not get there because of something that went wrong with his travel.

ctx.x: If people listen to some of your solo alto work do you think that they feel that you’re playing whatever you want to play like you said Bud Powell was?

Well I don’t know about that but I’ll tell you about my experience in Willisau, Switzerland. I was there with the Art Ensemble. We had played a concert. Anthony Braxton could not get there because of something that went wrong with his travel. So Niklaus Troxler, and I don’t know if you have this record, do you?
